backup.production_rule: replace with a fresh immutable production restore point during the approved cutover window

forward_verification.name: cleaner_submitter_audit_exists
forward_verification.query: select exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='cleaning_sessions' and column_name='submitted_by_user_id')

forward_verification.name: cleaning_photos_private
forward_verification.query: select public = false from storage.buckets where id='cleaning-photos'

rollback.safe_until: before any named-cleaner production write; after writes, forward-fix or restore from the approved production restore point

steps.name: hold_pwa_release
steps.action: keep the authenticated cleaner PWA unpublished or restore the previously served Pages artifact

steps.name: hold_edge_release
steps.action: do not advance the three Edge Function versions when any migration or Auth precondition fails

steps.name: restore_if_data_conversion_started
steps.action: use the approved immutable production restore point; do not run a destructive down migration

compatibility.evidence: 63 pgTAP, 3 backend boundary, 2 shared-auth Deno, Edge type-check and 5 PWA tests passed locally

stop_conditions: production migration ledger differs from source
fresh immutable production restore point is absent
real cleaner account and property assignment are not proven
either backend or PWA cannot deploy in the same staffed window
any forward verification query differs from its expected result
